issue: Edit action fully disabled on blocked tasks instead of allowing partial edit
actual: For a blocked task (e.g. "Complete tax filing", blocked by incomplete "Review project proposal"), the edit (pen) button is fully disabled (element has disabled attribute) and clicking it does not open the edit dialog at all. There is no way to modify description or priority while blocked; only the delete (trash) button remains enabled.

Completing "Review project proposal v2" then unblocked "Complete tax filing"; completing that unblocked "Submit final report" ("2 prerequisites completed", toggle enabled). Confirms tasks become eligible for completion only after all prerequisites are completed.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves its completed dependent in an invalid completed+blocked state
actual: "Review project proposal v2" was completed while its prerequisite "Buy groceries" was also completed. Reopening "Buy groceries" (toggling it back to active) was allowed without restriction, and "Review project proposal v2" remained in the Completed view/count (Completed 5->4 only reflects Buy groceries reopening, task still listed under Completed) while simultaneously showing "Prerequisite \"Buy groceries\" incomplete" and having its complete/reopen toggle disabled. The system neither prevented reopening the prerequisite nor returned the completed dependent task to an incomplete state; it remains marked completed and blocked at the same time.
